name: 0xArchive
description:
0xArchive gives Claude direct access to deep market data for Hyperliquid and Lighter.xyz, so you can research, backtest, and answer market questions in conversation instead of writing collection scripts. Coverage spans Hyperliquid perpetuals, spot pairs, HIP-3 builder markets, and HIP-4 outcome markets, plus Lighter.xyz. Available data includes:

Order books. L2 aggregated depth and full L4 order-level books with individual order IDs, per-order sizes, and wallet attribution. Point-in-time reconstruction at any timestamp, periodic checkpoints, and raw order-level diffs.

Trades and orders. Trade and fill history with maker and taker sides, order lifecycle events, TP/SL trigger orders, TWAP execution status, and aggregated order flow.

Derivatives data. Funding rates, open interest, mark and oracle prices, candles from 1m to 1w, liquidation events and volume, and projected liquidation level maps computed from clearinghouse position state.

Data quality. Every dataset reports its own coverage, freshness, and latency, and there are tools for incident history and SLA reporting. Coverage start dates differ per dataset and venue, so ask the coverage tools rather than assuming a range.

Common uses: pull tick-level trades and order book states for backtesting, inspect where liquidation risk and resting stop orders cluster around current price, compare depth, funding, and open interest across venues, and check data completeness before relying on a range.

Any 0xArchive account can connect, including the free tier. Usage is metered by credits rather than gated by dataset, so every data type is reachable on every plan.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 0xArchive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 0xArchive to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.0xarchive.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 0xArchive MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 0xArchive lists 119 MCP tools, including get_candles, get_data_coverage, get_data_incidents, get_data_latency, get_data_quality_status, get_data_sla, get_exchange_coverage, get_freshness, get_funding_current, get_funding_history, get_hip3_candles, and get_hip3_freshness.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 0xArchive?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 0xArchive in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
0xArchive requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
0xArchive is developed by 0xArchive. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
